Section A, new, from the Orbits recipe. Orbits, with rain on stabs and hits. The wire unicorn is the centrepiece. The cosmos: the camera flies with the track, drawn in by builds and let go on drops, each section on the galaxy arm that suits it. The glow flies behind the planets. Sparkles pop on the stabs. Changes fade in. Colours: three far-apart hues. Pace: steady, pulsing every other beat.
